results.title: Oil Gobblers
results.overview: A zoologist and a biochemist go out into an oilfield with a cameraman and filmmaker to observe and study the elusive oil gobblers.

results.title: The Girl, the Bad, and the Oblivious
results.original_title: The Girl, the Bad, and the Oblivious
results.overview: When Alex's former best friend drags him into an extravagant heist, they must overcome unexpected obstacles to regain what one loves most.

results.title: Attention Seeker
results.overview: The Powers, a picturesque family. David Powers, a classic country singer with a comeback album on the horizon works away with his tools on the grounds of the estate. Janet Powers, the matriarch of the house toiling away in the kitchen preparing a feast for the family. Ben Powers, buried amongst the various computer windows of gameplay, text chats, and live streaming feeds. And Grace, dejected with a black eye starring into old pictures of days when she thought she was happy. One click is all it would take, it wouldn't undo any of what she's been through, and yeah it would probably make it all worse, she'd be attacked by everyone, the whole family would. A single click on the 'publish' button, and everything would come out, everything about her father, what it's like to live in this house. 'Why not' she thinks, 'I won't be here to see it, burn it all down'.

results.title: I Didn't Do It
results.overview: A detective rejects the claim that his daughter took her own life, chasing deadly secrets that lead to baffling questions and shocking truths.

results.title: Between Breath & Silence
results.overview: As his father's health rapidly declines, Tom returns home to face a family he has learned to keep at arm's length. Over the course of a single day, quiet moments, half heard conversations, and unspoken truths surface as Tom, his family, and the palliative care team navigate the fragile space between hope and acceptance. Struggling to communicate what matters most, Tom must confront the weight of what he has never said, and what time may no longer allow him to say. Set against the intimate backdrop of a working class family in Stoke-on-Trent, Between Breath and Silence explores love, loss, and the complexities of communication when words fall short.

results.title: Drifts
results.overview: While camping on the coast of Maine a father and son cross paths with a burnt-out photographer, sparking something in her that she long since buried.

results.title: Cry Out
results.overview: Akiko, a girl living a hard life after her father passes away and her mother's new boyfriend turns abusive, starts receiving encouraging letters from her 30-year-old-future self. Akiko also starts to get bullied in school, and her teacher Shinomiya tries to help her, but ends up losing her job. Akiko also unearths a story written to her by her father, telling her how he originally met her mother, who was the abused daughter of a politician.

results.title: Boy
results.overview: On the edge of a corrupt city lies the "Texas Hot Spring," run by brothers Ro-han and Gyo-han. Ro-han meets Jae-in, a girl abused by her mother, and ends up selling her drugs, causing her death. Meanwhile, Gyo-han, allied with the local crime boss, decides to sell Jae-in, blaming her for his brother's change in behavior. Ro-han refuses and escapes with her, determined to protect her.

results.title: Demoniac
results.overview: A guy talks to the AI all day long. Something is approaching.

results.title: Iron Farm
results.overview: Police officers Rahim(Irfan Zaini) and Easwaran(Logavarman) begin investigating the disappearance of 15-year-old student in the town of Sri Tebong. As the investigation unfolds, they uncover hidden secrets, unexpected connections, and dark truths buried within the community and the mysteries hidden behind ordinary lives.

results.title: Black Black
results.overview: At a Fourth of July barbecue, an interracial couple's celebration implodes when a private group chat about their biracial daughter's hair accidentally streams to the TV--forcing a Black father to confront racism inside his own home.

results.title: Disney Celebrates America: The Pursuit of Happiness
results.original_title: Disney Celebrates America: The Pursuit of Happiness
results.overview: A coast-to-coast event exploring Disney Parks and attractions as a portal through which America's greatest stories, triumphs and traditions are celebrated.

results.title: Fix
results.overview: When Victoria, a pharmaceutical executive, discovers her long-lost brother Damian is homeless and struggling with addiction, she takes a bold step-secretly administering an experimental drug to help him get back on his feet. All seems to be going well until the drug runs out.

results.title: Tradfluencer - The Sharon Shannon Story
results.overview: An access all areas look at the life and career of renowned accordion virtuoso Sharon Shannon, featuring esteemed collaborators & exclusive behind-the-scenes moments from her gigs.

results.title: Raja The Raja
results.overview: An aspiring fashion designer fights to prove himself against his father's wishes. Just as love enters his life, a mysterious disappearance sets him on an unforgettable journey into a hidden world where his true destiny awaits.

results.title: 144 – Apocalypse Not
results.overview: After a satirical tweet targeting Bolsonaro and the Universal Church, J.P. Cuenca became the target of 144 lawsuits and thousands of death threats from the evangelical far right. Seeking dialogue, he embarks on an 11,000-kilometer journey through packed churches, rodeos, German festivals, shooting clubs, home worship services, and gospel trucks across every region of Brazil. Amid ecological devastation, religious fervor, and an impending apocalypse, a Brazil in trance reaches an apotheosis of color, music, and faith.

results.title: Corpse Pose
results.overview: The vinyasa flow is interrupted in this yoga class when the substitute yoga teacher turns out to be a spy.

results.title: A Thrift Story
results.overview: It’s Amy’s last day at the no-name thrift store where she works, but she’s got one last difficult customer to deal with.
